items.title: CVE-2026-124194 — Microsoft Office Outlook Missing User Interaction for Potentially Unsafe Action Vulnerability
items.desc: Microsoft Office Outlook contains a missing user interaction for potentially unsafe action vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

items.title: CVE-2026-111793 — Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder Incorrect Resource Transfer Between Spheres Vulnerability
items.desc: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability that may allow an authenticated user to process and convert unintended document types if bypassing the Webmail experience.
tags: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder

items.title: CVE-2026-20320 — Cisco BroadWorks Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference Vulnerability
items.desc: Cisco BroadWorks contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information on an affected system.

items.title: CVE-2026-59310 — Broadcom VMware vCenter Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.desc: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a threat actor with network access to vCenter to execute arbitrary code.

items.title: CVE-2026-63077 — JetBrains TeamCity Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
items.desc: JetBrains TeamCity contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution via the agent polling protocol.

items.title: CVE-2026-15409 — SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
items.desc: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contain a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to potentially cause the appliance to make requests to unintended location.

items.title: CVE-2026-15410 — SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Code Injection Vulnerability
items.desc: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contain a code injection vulnerability which in specific conditions could potentially enable a remote authenticated attacker as administrator to execute arbitrary OS commands.
